verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Sandbox0's source is published under an open license. The pack only shows that an SDK package path and a CLI repository live on GitHub, with no license stated and nothing about the core platform's source. Openness is a fair question for a managed sandbox platform, so this is "none", not "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
